# eBay Community

> > The eBay Community is a peer-to-peer support platform where buyers and sellers connect through discussion groups, share marketplace insights, and collaborate on fraud prevention and seller protection.

This community hub hosts specialized user groups covering topics from buyer scam reporting to creative projects like Round Robin Living. Members exchange knowledge about eBay selling strategies, category-specific advice, and marketplace best practices.

## Key Topics

- eBay Community
- Community Groups
- Seller Resources
- Buyer Scammers
- Fraud Prevention
- Seller Protection
- eBay Motors
- User Groups
- Community Hub
- eBay Categories
- Round Robin Living
- eBay Groups

## Seller Protection & Fraud Prevention

- [Buyer Scammers](https://community.ebay.com/t5/Buyer-Scammers/cmp-p/grouphub%3Ag-1500004708): Community group for reporting buyer scams and protecting eBay sellers

## Optional Community Groups

- [Round Robin Living](https://community.ebay.com/t5/Round-Robin-Living/cmp-p/grouphub%3Ag-1500004272): eBay community group for round robin art project and mutual support
- [Undogmatic feedback](https://community.ebay.com/t5/Undogmatic-feedback/cmp-p/grouphub%3Ag-1500003198): Community group for German eBay users seeking alternative discussion space
- [Bennett & Tp](https://community.ebay.com/t5/Bennett-Tp/cmp-p/grouphub%3Ag-1500004722): eBay community group for chatting and item information discussion
- [Desperados](https://community.ebay.com/t5/Desperados/cmp-p/grouphub%3Ag-1600003961): General discussion eBay community group for casual conversation
